sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of centanafadine during breastfeeding. Because centanafadine is over 99% bound to plasma proteins, the amount in milk is likely to be low. If centanafadine is required by the mother, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding, but until more data become available, an alternate drug may be preferred, especially while nursing a newborn or preterm infant.
